notes.title: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition is out now!
notes.notes:
Greetings Mighty Warriors of Ashan! 

We’re glad to announce that [b]Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition[/b] is available on PC starting today with a [b]15% launch discount[/b] for everyone and an [b]additional 40% discount for original owners[/b]. Please note that both discounts will be available for two weeks only.  

Play Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213300/Might__Magic_Clash_of_Heroes__Definitive_Edition/ 

If you’ve never played Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes before, here’s a small introduction to this incredible gem from the past. 

Anwen, Godric, Fiona, Aidan, and Nadia are five mighty heroes scattered around five different regions of Ashan. After the rise of the demons, these heroes battle their way through their respective kingdoms to unravel the mysteries behind the chaos threatening their world. 

[h3][b]How to play Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definite Edition?[/b][/h3] 

The game is a puzzle RPG game with unique and deep gameplay mechanics that makes it fun to play and quickly addictive. We recently released a gameplay trailer that teaches you everything you need to know to begin your incredible journey through the lands of Ashan. 

[previewyoutube=baXocheKqP0;full][/previewyoutube]

As a result, all you need to do to play and defeat unit enemies is to match three units of the same type and color vertically to create an attack. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/fee7ab079236754a121a0c28b69be8861449f7cf.gif[/img]

Matching three or more units of the same color horizontally will build a defensive wall. You can also reinforce them by building additional walls. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/18cb3cfcccecd9a19b7e5bece25b7b0165f3a8b3.gif[/img]

[b]Catch intel about Factions, units, and gameplay mechanics with our Gameplay Introduction Blogpost: [/b]https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692432394700854281?snr=1_2108_9__2107

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213300/Might__Magic_Clash_of_Heroes__Definitive_Edition/

notes.title: Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes' 'Definitive Edition' updates almost nothing, but at least it's a second chance for the best puzzle RPG ever made
notes.notes: I have such fond memories of the original Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes that I was thrilled when a modern remaster was announced, dubbed its "Definitive Edition". When I saw that it now has a demo available as part of Steam Next Fest, I leapt at the excuse to dive back into its colourful, puzzle filled world. But after having finished it, I'm left disappointed at how subtle an update this is... Read more.

notes.title: Character Profile: Nadia - Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
notes.notes:
Greetings Mighty Heroes,

Let's take a closer look at [b]Nadia[/b] and the [b]Academy Faction[/b] today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/7f407b80911501175d44b571869b6d1de0232b88.png[/img]

As mentioned in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692431761895959001]World & Characters[/url] blogpost, Nadia is the daughter of a respected Mage of the Silver Cities, she is [b]a powerful wizard[/b] herself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/2cfeee9389770dc6776288d71e1e98ada9aac130.gif[/img]

[b]If you aren't familiar with Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition's combat, we strongly encourage you to read our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692432394700854281]Gameplay Introduction blogpost[/url] before reading any further.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/da0fe502494aedf72f7c5e0be7b04be59587a90d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/c0f76889e09575e509e32cd2c8083e0baddb5b2c.gif[/img]

Nadia's unique spell [b]summons lightning bolts[/b] that randomly strike the enemy's battlefield. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/d44ba2e51dbc61f0c6263dc13f9aa94ff316fb38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/ed2c7b73943f03cf99c6c72a98d4961368e737a5.gif[/img]

These units have [b]the fastest charging time[/b] (from one to three turns) but deal [b]the lowest damage[/b]. Academy Core Units are the following:

[u][b]Apprentices[/b][/u]
These units shoot stinging magical bolts at the enemy after one turn. They are the fastest and weakest Academy Core Unit. However, they are extremely useful to [b]take out Elite or Champion units before they charge their attack.[/b]

[u][b]Gremlins[/b][/u]
These units shoot a magical blast at the enemy after two turns. They are [b]the most powerful of all Academy Core Units[/b]. However, their attack deals powerful damage to the first enemy in the row and weakens as it travels further. A useful unit to [b]take out a charging enemy[/b] (who are at the front of a row)

[u][b]Golems[/b][/u]
These units slash the enemy with their Scimitars after three turns. Powerwise, they are stronger than Apprentices but weaker than Gremlins, making them an all-around balanced unit.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/07249c07b68f9bf0e102f8e3057a5dba6edb2a95.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/b2ad7c818d476e77f855a3debff558ced5cfa519.gif[/img]

These units deal [b]more damage[/b] than Core Units but [b]take up more space[/b] on the battlefield, making them trickier to activate. Academy Elite Units are the following:

[u][b]Wizards[/b][/u]
These units cast a bolt of lightning that spreads through any idle units it touches after four turns. If used strategically, this unit is extremely effective at[b] thinning out enemy lines.[/b]

[u][b]Djinns[/b][/u]
These units cast an attack after three turns that [b]freezes every attack formation for three turns[/b]. The frozen formations are extremely vulnerable to other attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/65f122fc3ae45eaf8cfb4ea4b2781018c011e407.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/759eff19adce6106557dc595364b9624ebe50bcc.gif[/img]

These units are undoubtedly [b]the most important of your army[/b] as they deal the most damage over a large area. However, they are even larger than Elite Units and require more Core Units to activate their attack, which takes longer to charge as well. Academy Champion Units are the following:

[u][b]Rakshasas[/b][/u]
These units deliver a powerful attack on the enemy after five turns. If this attack manages to reach the enemy hero, it will [b]deplete an equal amount of both their HP and MP, [/b] making this a useful way to prevent enemy hero spells.

[u][b]Titans[/b][/u]
These units send a [b]powerful shockwave[/b] across the enemy's battlefield after six turns, which [b]damages connected walls. [/b]

[u][b]Phoenix[/b][/u]
These units spit fire at the enemy after five turns. Moreover, they will [b]resurrect Formations if they die while sites charging.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/b2325b3f755243d9c9f7eb3b49deef9e475dedf1.png[/img]

Academy walls have a base strength of 6 HP and [b]gain 5 HP with each additional wall formed![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/707e786f1ee3b115a5fe370c4cb21415fb08e522.png[/img]

That's all for Nadia and the Academy Faction! Stay tuned for more advanced gameplay tips in the future!
Thank you for your interest in Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition!

notes.title: Character Profile: Aidan - Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
notes.notes:
Greetings Mighty Heroes,

Let's take a closer look at [b]Aidan[/b] and the [b]Inferno Faction[/b] today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/c039233cfb333600b074ec72764e1e42cb51901f.png[/img]

As mentioned in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692431761895959001]World & Characters[/url] blogpost, Aidan Unicorn is the youngest sibling of the Unicorn Duchy. After finding a mysterious dagger, he finds himself able to [b]control demons[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/f5351083b8699e1aa3706ffe38dc23a0c3a04d82.gif[/img]
[b]If you aren't familiar with Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition's combat, we strongly encourage you to read our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692432394700854281]Gameplay Introduction blogpost[/url] before reading any further.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/da0fe502494aedf72f7c5e0be7b04be59587a90d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/1dad78900b27eefd445a23ba83a5427081e473a4.gif[/img]

Aidan's unique spell [b]transforms every wall on the battlefield into fire balls[/b] which are then launched at the enemy. This spell can be quite helpful in catching enemies off-guard: even though it may appear you are adopting a defensive stance, you are actually building ammunition for a powerful attack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/d44ba2e51dbc61f0c6263dc13f9aa94ff316fb38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/352929cac46893b2aefefdccc3da90f7ad6a12fc.gif[/img]

These units have [b]the fastest charging time[/b] (from one to three turns) but deal [b]the lowest damage[/b]. Inferno Core Units are the following:

[u][b]Horned Demons[/b][/u]
These units claw at the enemy after three turns. They are a straightforward unit with [b]the most attack power out of all Inferno Core Units.[/b]

[u][b]Imps[/b][/u]
These units lunge toward the enemy after three turns. If their attack hits an enemy attack formation, they will explode dealing [b]splash damage[/b]. 

[u][b]Hell Hounds[/b][/u]
These units launch their attacks at the enemy after two turns, making them [b]the fastest of the Inferno Core Units.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/07249c07b68f9bf0e102f8e3057a5dba6edb2a95.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/9ea88d423bb11c6d858cfc3005bda9b7e5e344ee.gif[/img]

These units deal [b]more damage[/b] than Core Units but [b]take up more space[/b] on the battlefield, making them trickier to activate. Inferno Elite Units are the following:

[u][b]Succubi[/b][/u]
These units fire four explosive blasts of hellfire after four turns. These blasts cover a large area, inflicting splash damage to surrounding units. An excellent unit to[b] thin out enemy lines.[/b]

[u][b]Nightmares[/b][/u]
These units lunge at the enemy after four turns. Their attack is weaker than the Succubi but all Nightmare formations will launch[b] their attacks simultaneously, regardless of their remaining charge time. [/b]

[u][b]Sorcerers[/b][/u]
These units launch dark magic at the enemy after three turns. Their attack is the weakest out of all Elite Units, but it can [b]break apart any enemy formation it hits, turning it idle.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/65f122fc3ae45eaf8cfb4ea4b2781018c011e407.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/5d6b810c520c317b7623afe21c75bae734891b6a.gif[/img]

These units are undoubtedly [b]the most important of your army[/b] as they deal the most damage over a large area. However, they are even larger than Elite Units and require more Core Units to activate their attack, which takes longer to charge as well. Inferno Champion Units are the following:

[u][b]Abyssal Lords[/b][/u]
These units launch a devastating attack after five turns. During their charging time, they [b]absorb some power from any fallen ally formations.[/b]

[u][b]Pit Fiends[/b][/u]
These units a fiery attack after five turns, leaving behind [b]the burning bodies of any defeated units.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/b2325b3f755243d9c9f7eb3b49deef9e475dedf1.png[/img]

Inferno walls have a base strength of 5 HP and[b] burn enemy units that cross them[/b] for a short distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/707e786f1ee3b115a5fe370c4cb21415fb08e522.png[/img]

That's all for Aidan and the Inferno Faction! Stay tuned for more advanced gameplay tips in the future!
Thank you for your interest in Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition!

notes.title: Character Profile: Fiona - Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
notes.notes:
Greetings Mighty Heroes,

Let's take a closer look at [b]Fiona[/b] and the [b]Necropolis Faction[/b] today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/c8895de1186b5bebbf1b7c246cd9dff245cb1aab.png[/img]

As mentioned in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692431761895959001]World & Characters[/url] blogpost, Fiona Unicorn is the sole daughter of the Unicorn Duchy. She became a ghost and is now [b]a Necromancer commanding an undead army[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/ca21986f71c35c6225a49df9c3050aaf9fbd1fc6.gif[/img]

[b]If you aren't familiar with Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition's combat, we strongly encourage you to read our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692432394700854281]Gameplay Introduction blogpost[/url] before reading any further.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/da0fe502494aedf72f7c5e0be7b04be59587a90d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/b5cd6ffcbea9c0bc1b29dfbbd7848b35d8429efd.gif[/img]

Fiona's unique spell [b]sacrifices all her idle units on the battlefield to produce a powerful energy ball[/b] she can then launch at the enemy. The sacrificed units leave behind piles of bones that transform into defensive walls, making this spell [b]well-balanced in offense and defense[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/d44ba2e51dbc61f0c6263dc13f9aa94ff316fb38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/274a44e630f572b79a1559fdef18f327fbf72308.gif[/img]

These units have [b]the fastest charging time[/b] (from one to three turns) but deal [b]the lowest damage[/b]. Necropolis Core Units are the following:

[u][b]Skeletons[/b][/u]
These units move toward the enemy and bash them with their bony skulls after two turns. A unit that deals a good amount of damage with a relatively low charging time

[u][b]Zombies[/b][/u]
These units inflict a plagued bite on the enemy after two turns. Afflicted enemies will continuously lose HP at the beginning of every turn. This [b]life-draining ability [/b]is incredibly useful to lower Elite and Champion Unit attacks (which get more powerful while they charge)

[u][b]Ebon Guards[/b][/u]
These units slash the enemy with their ritual daggers after three turns. They are the strongest of all the Necropolis Core Units.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/07249c07b68f9bf0e102f8e3057a5dba6edb2a95.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/d79f4e234d4acd36dd84178d54050fdfb97b882f.gif[/img]

These units deal [b]more damage[/b] than Core Units but [b]take up more space[/b] on the battlefield, making them trickier to activate. Necropolis Elite Units are the following:

[u][b]Vampires[/b][/u]
These units transform into a deadly cloud of bats and charge at the enemy after four turns. Their attack [b]drains the life force of the enemy [/b]and transfers it to Fiona’s HP.

[u][b]Ghosts[/b][/u]
These units launch an attack after three turns. While charging their attack, [b]they are immune to damage and deal damage to enemies[/b] that pass through them.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/65f122fc3ae45eaf8cfb4ea4b2781018c011e407.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/70eb6c66818ee0450c2ee93753e430a95f72d79e.gif[/img]

These units are undoubtedly [b]the most important of your army[/b] as they deal the most damage over a large area. However, they are even larger than Elite Units and require more Core Units to activate their attack, which takes longer to charge as well. Necropolis Champion Units are the following:

[u][b]Bone Dragons[/b][/u]
These units devour the enemy with their bony mouths after five turns. During their attack, they swallow idle enemies and transform their toughness into additional attack power. If used well, these units will [b]gather more power as they cross enemy lines[/b] to deal a fatal blow to the enemy hero’s HP bar.

[u][b]Death Knights[/b][/u]
These units launch a wave of dark energy after six turns. Their charging time may be long but it is actually an advantage as during that time [b]they continuously drain the life force of enemy units[/b] to strengthen their own attack.

[u][b]Wraiths[/b][/u]
These units launch a devastating after five turns. They have the unique ability to deliver instant death to anything their touch, including the enemy hero’s HP. However, they are quite fragile while charging, making them[b] high-risk, high-reward units[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/b2325b3f755243d9c9f7eb3b49deef9e475dedf1.png[/img]

Necropolis walls have a base strength of 6 HP and all idle units that die [b]leave behind piles of bones that form walls.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/707e786f1ee3b115a5fe370c4cb21415fb08e522.png[/img]

That's all for Fiona and the Necropolis Faction! Stay tuned for more advanced gameplay tips in the future!
Thank you for your interest in Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition!

notes.title: Character Profile: Godric - Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
notes.notes:
Greetings Mighty Heroes,

Let's take a closer look at [b]Godric[/b] and the [b]Haven Faction[/b] today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/44491cf1c0e48f340034b061a63159deabe73877.png[/img]

As mentioned in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692431761895959001]World & Characters[/url] blogpost, Godric Unicorn is a promising young Knight of the Holy Griffin Empire. He is the eldest son of the Unicorn Duchy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/0f3467bb284f9536e81846d1e6feb542de477b1a.gif[/img]

[b]If you aren't familiar with Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition's combat, we strongly encourage you to read our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692432394700854281]Gameplay Introduction blogpost[/url] before reading any further.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/da0fe502494aedf72f7c5e0be7b04be59587a90d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/b7fae3a5ae29df17725a30c6475c047e29160f43.gif[/img]

Godric's unique spell [b]erects a defensive shield worth 50% of his HP[/b] at the bottom of the battlefield. This allows his HP bar to be protected for one turn. Afterward, the shield [b]transforms into magic missiles[/b] that are launched at the enemy. This spell can get you out of near-death situations so use it wisely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/d44ba2e51dbc61f0c6263dc13f9aa94ff316fb38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/a6fe5bb448a9c4ac308f82e049bd62dba0ce0984.gif[/img]

These units have [b]the fastest charging time[/b] (from one to three turns) but deal [b]the lowest damage[/b]. Haven Core Units are the following:

[u][b]Swordsmen[/b][/u]
These units lunge toward the enemy with swords after three turns. [b]They are the strongest out of all Haven Core Units[/b], an all-around balanced unit that is easy to use and gives excellent results.

[u][b]Spearmen[/b][/u]
These units thrust their spears at their enemy after three turns. Though they deal less damage than swordsmen, if they collide with an enemy with a lower PWR than them[b] they will pass through them and eliminate them without losing any PWR[/b]! Excellent units to target the enemy’s HP bar directly.

[u][b]Archers[/b][/u]
These units shoot arrows at the enemy after two turns. They are the fastest Haven Core Unit and are excellent at [b]taking out Elite and Champion Units before they begin charging[/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/07249c07b68f9bf0e102f8e3057a5dba6edb2a95.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/64903993199dfab9cddfe1299d9838bfef233c58.gif[/img]

These units deal [b]more damage[/b] than Core Units but [b]take up more space[/b] on the battlefield, making them trickier to activate. Haven Elite Units are the following:

[u][b]Knights[/b][/u]
These units charge toward the enemy on horseback after four turns. While charging[b] they are protected from damage up to 50% of their max PWR[/b]. They deal the most damage out of all Haven Elite Units. This makes them ideal units to target the enemy hero’s HP directly as they will survive the frontlines easily.

[u][b]Priestesses[/b][/u]
These units [b]heal the hero’s HP continuously[/b] while they are charging their attack. They launch a powerful energy blast after four turns.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/65f122fc3ae45eaf8cfb4ea4b2781018c011e407.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/c44931f702f168bcb729ac9496b1f580dd44583b.gif[/img]

These units are undoubtedly [b]the most important of your army[/b] as they deal the most damage over a large area. However, they are even larger than Elite Units and require more Core Units to activate their attack, which takes longer to charge as well. Haven Champion Units are the following:

[u][b]Angels[/b][/u]
They will [b]heal your units as they are charging their attack[/b]. They also fire a powerful blast of holy light after six turns, incinerating two columns of enemies

[u][b]Griffins[/b][/u]
These units fly toward the enemy after five turns. If they encounter a strong enemy or reach the enemy’s HP bar, they will do a dive attack that is equal to [b]2 times their current PWR[/b].

[u][b]Sword Masters[/b][/u]
At the start of each turn, these gigantic Knights will slam their sword to the ground, [b]creating powerful shockwaves as they charge their attack[/b]. After six turns, they will unleash a wave of giant blades thrusting from the earth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/b2325b3f755243d9c9f7eb3b49deef9e475dedf1.png[/img]

Haven walls have no special ability but they have the [b]highest base HP out of all factions![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/707e786f1ee3b115a5fe370c4cb21415fb08e522.png[/img]

That's all for Godric and the Haven Faction! Stay tuned for more advanced gameplay tips in the future!
Thank you for your interest in Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition!

notes.title: Character Profile: Anwen - Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
notes.notes:
Greetings Mighty Heroes,

Let's take a closer look at [b]Anwen[/b] and the [b]Sylvan Faction[/b] today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/9fe532f6573a8599535fba3c5208fe1ce74f9583.png[/img]

As mentioned in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692431761895959001]World & Characters[/url] blogpost, Anwen is an [b]elven hero[/b] from the magical Irollan forest. She is a ranger who is extremely skilled with a bow. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/a30b4a7ba839c419d16ffbdaafed069401f56ce8.gif[/img]

[b]If you aren't familiar with Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition's combat, we strongly encourage you to read our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2213300/announcements/detail/3692432394700854281]Gameplay Introduction blogpost[/url] before reading any further.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/da0fe502494aedf72f7c5e0be7b04be59587a90d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/6ff37a14a76a9a1adaccee4805c5df0042cef323.gif[/img]

Anwen's unique spell allows her to shoot [b]a volley of arrows[/b] at her enemy, dealing massive amounts of damage to three selected enemy columns and the enemy's HP bar!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/d44ba2e51dbc61f0c6263dc13f9aa94ff316fb38.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/2362211e5ac5682787494b4ac3c5d57364c1423c.gif[/img]

These units have [b]the fastest charging time[/b] (from one to three turns) but deal [b]the lowest damage[/b]. Sylvan Core Units are the following:

[u][b]Hunters[/b][/u]
These units shoot warding arrows[b] only after a single turn[/b], making them perfect for quickly getting rid of Elite or Champion Units before they start charging their dangerous attacks.

[u][b]Bears[/b][/u]
These units run toward the enemy and maul them after two turns. Their attack is [b]the strongest out of all Sylvan Core Units[/b] and they are slightly more sturdy than other Core Units when idle (not charging an attack).

[u][b]Pixies[/b][/u]
These units launch a magical burst of pixie dust after two turns. The attack's damage is scaled off the hero's current spell meter level. This makes pixies either very weak or very strong depending on your spell meter management. In fact, when the spell meter is over halfway full, [b]their attack becomes the strongest of all Core Units[/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/07249c07b68f9bf0e102f8e3057a5dba6edb2a95.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/8a380d2232aad4dce59b8dd1f379557aad7e228b.gif[/img]

These units deal [b]more damage[/b] than Core Units but [b]take up more space[/b] on the battlefield, making them trickier to activate. Sylvan Elite Units are the following:

[u][b]Druids[/b][/u]
These units cast a magical vine spell after two turns that [b]increases the charging time[/b] of any enemy formation it hits by two turns. Incredibly useful to stall a Champion Unit's devastating attack.

[u][b]Deers[/b][/u]
These units charge at enemy lines jumping over one row of enemy walls after three turns. A useful unit that disregards enemy defenses and deals [b]the most damage out of all Sylvan Elite Units[/b].

[u][b]Unicorns[/b][/u]
These units [b]protect themselves and surrounding columns[/b] with a defensive aura while charging their attack. They deal the lowest damage out of all Sylvan Elite Units but can be an invaluable resource against aggressive opponents.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/65f122fc3ae45eaf8cfb4ea4b2781018c011e407.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/543ce05525f51efa5ead7c2c9bfda5157522b0d2.gif[/img]

These units are undoubtedly [b]the most important of your army[/b] as they deal the most damage over a large area. However, they are even larger than Elite Units and require more Core Units to activate their attack, which takes longer to charge as well. Sylvan Champion Units are the following:

[u][b]Treants[/b][/u]
These units sprout huge roots across the battlefield. If it manages to hit the enemy hero's HP bar, the vines will stay on the battlefield and [b]drain health from the enemy [/b] at every turn.
They deal the most damage out of all Sylvan Champion Units but take the longest to charge (five turns)

[u][b]Emerald Dragons [/b][/u]
These units spray a jet of [b]acid that remains on the battlefield[/b] for one turn and damages any enemy that touches it. A very useful unit to disrupt enemy positioning. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/b2325b3f755243d9c9f7eb3b49deef9e475dedf1.png[/img]

Sylvan walls have the unique ability to regenerate themselves for 2 HP after each turn. A useful ability that will save you from spending your limited moves constantly rebuilding walls!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/707e786f1ee3b115a5fe370c4cb21415fb08e522.png[/img]

That's all for Anwen and the Sylvan Faction for now, but don't forget that there are many ways to fight with this character! You can customize your playstyle by choosing specific units, but also by choosing the right [b]Artifact[/b] (we will talk about these later on in our advanced gameplay blogpost!). 

Thank you for your interest in Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition!

notes.title: Gameplay Introduction to Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
notes.notes:
Greetings Mighty Heroes!

Today we want to give you a quick gameplay introduction to Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/e1e34841552aeaa62cccde7ecac0e5782ecde656.png[/img]

Take control of your hero’s units on the battlefield and maneuver them to create impenetrable defenses or devastating attacks!

Match three units of the same type and color vertically to [b]create an attack formation[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/9eca5d169655da256886c7215b468a2bc18cd28e.gif[/img]

Notice the blue number appearing on top of the formation? This indicates the [b]number of turns until the attack is charged[/b]. Once that number falls to zero, the units will unleash their attack:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/d6449b7891482ffa6e7a427d634ed4ba73d1dcbe.gif[/img]

Match three or more units of the same color horizontally to [b]form a defensive wall[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/7613e3b6c65d511614ea07119b86e6a47b72d752.gif[/img]

These walls form immediately and can be reinforced by [b]building additional walls behind them[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/8dbc9962e5b1221126062712f453bbaaba1bac47.gif[/img]

Each unit you unlock during the game will have unique stats:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/a0f43b8d3ccd14954ccedac87ab59f1b5a76bbcd.png[/img]
It is essential to understand each one to maximize your chances of winning:
[list]
[*] XP: This bar will fill up as you defeat enemies. Once it is full your unit will level up.
[*] LVL: This determines your unit's overall stats. As this goes up, your unit will become stronger.
[*] Sword Icon: This is your unit's PWR level. This indicates how much damage the unit's attack will deal after it is charged. This damage will be spread out across all the enemies the attack formation will face. 
[b][u]Important:[/u][/b] A unit's PWR level not only indicates its damage but also its defense. Therefore, a unit can withstand as high of an attack as it can deal.
[*] Hourglass Icon: This represents your unit's charging time. It shows how many turns it takes for its attack to charge.
[*] Heart icon: This represents how much damage your unit can withstand when it is idle (not in an attack formation).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/9922a90d2ad08c6bcdf36777c32fd33085a22a4c.png[/img]

Factions determine which [b]specific set of units[/b] are available to equip in battle. For example, the Sylvan Faction is composed of woodland creatures, whereas the Inferno Faction is made up of demonic creatures. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/e75f318abe5727a23a805e7581312a9f3ee16347.gif[/img]

Each faction also offers [b]a unique wall ability[/b]: one can repair walls over time, while another can make walls burn enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/fc45edae95271320ff8e8d1caf0c30da207859c5.png[/img]

Elite and Champion units are [b]pivotal resources in a battle[/b]. Their attacks take longer to charge and are harder to activate, but are more powerful and can be devastating finishers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/def3f6b317d13dc2e453b334e914d5845f559f28.gif[/img]

Contrary to ordinary “core” units, Elite and Champion units are [b]limited in number[/b], therefore you will have to buy them again if they fall in battle. Use them wisely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/50a182ce2461516e8de63d9bc30181a37a2b7cc6.png[/img]

Each hero possesses [b]a unique spell [/b]that can be activated when their spell meter is full.

The spell meter replenishes itself every time you inflict or receive damage and create formations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/8de5d2359b4586e204195b49461363d4ac6d3bbf.gif[/img]

From shooting giant arrows to summoning lightning bolts, each hero’s unique spell can be the difference between defeat and victory!

This was just an introduction to MM:COH - DE’s gameplay. There are many more mechanics we have yet to cover, as well as advanced gameplay strategies! Stay tuned for more content like this and don't forget to:

notes.title: The World and Characters of Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes - Definitive Edition
notes.notes:
Welcome Mighty Heroes!

While the game has not yet launched, we wanted to take this opportunity to offer a small guide to its world and characters, especially for those unfamiliar with the Might & Magic franchise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/ef4a766b3fa04f3f2fafc26fb69d714a2bf52f1d.png[/img]

Shattered by the never-ending struggle between Order and Chaos, [b]Ashan[/b] is the world of Might and Magic. It is comprised of many realms, of which you will explore four in MM: COH:

[h4]Irollan[/h4]A lush magical forest guarded by Elves 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/a30b4a7ba839c419d16ffbdaafed069401f56ce8.gif[/img]

[h4]The Holy Griffin Empire[/h4]A vast human empire ruled by Knights

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/0f3467bb284f9536e81846d1e6feb542de477b1a.gif[/img]

[h4]Heresh[/h4]A barren wasteland ruled by Necromancers

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/e8c05f472d2295fbc116093d8f79a91aa72c2558.gif[/img]

[h4]The Silver Cities[/h4]A desert kingdom ruled by Wizards

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/2cfeee9389770dc6776288d71e1e98ada9aac130.gif[/img]

[h4]Sheogh[/h4]The underground prison realm of Demons 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/f5351083b8699e1aa3706ffe38dc23a0c3a04d82.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/3a4dd1fe281d55a62f81ec508d55e1a2c1e39013.png[/img]

[b]Demons[/b] have long been at war with the inhabitants of [b]Ashan[/b].

Blood moons weakened the walls of their prison, letting them escape and lay waste to anything they could.

During the last Demon War, [b]The Blade of Binding[/b] was created. A powerful artifact that could bend any Demon to its wielder’s will. 

The Blade is now protected by a handful of allies in Ashan, but [b]dark forces coveting its power are on the move… [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/ff5a5d44af19e62a9b4aeca1a399d31d0a1970b6.png[/img]

While MM: COH is full of characters, we will focus on the five main playable characters today
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/9fe532f6573a8599535fba3c5208fe1ce74f9583.png[/img]
[b]An elf[/b] from the Irollan forest and the daughter of a ranger. She commands [b]Sylvan Faction[/b] units (Pixies, Bears, Druids…)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/44491cf1c0e48f340034b061a63159deabe73877.png[/img]The eldest son of the Unicorn Duchy of the Holy Griffin Empire. A promising [b]knight[/b] who commands [b]Haven Faction[/b] units (Swordsmen, Knights, Priestesses…)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/c8895de1186b5bebbf1b7c246cd9dff245cb1aab.png[/img]Godric’s younger sister. She rises from the dead as a ghost and [b]necromancer[/b]. She commands [b]Necropolis Faction[/b] units (Skeletons, Vampires, Ghosts…)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/c039233cfb333600b074ec72764e1e42cb51901f.png[/img]The youngest of the Unicorn siblings. He finds himself [b]trapped in Sheogh[/b], the realm of Demons, and discovers a mysterious blade allowing him to control [b]Inferno Faction[/b] units (Hellhounds, Succubi, Imps…)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44022569/7f407b80911501175d44b571869b6d1de0232b88.png[/img]The daughter of a respected Mage of the Silver Cities, she is a [b]wizard[/b] who controls [b]Academy Faction[/b] Units (Mages, Djinns, Golems…)

We'll explore each character's unique abilities and gameplay tips and tricks in upcoming posts!
Thank you again for your interest in the game and don't forget to:
